messages.content: what has the party done so far
The party has not yet taken any actions or made any progress in the adventure. They stand at the beginning of their journey, ready to explore what lies ahead.
There are no descriptions available for the characters at this time. The party’s appearances, backgrounds, and details have not yet been revealed in the course of their adventure.

The group stands before you: Garrick Almsford, a tall, square-framed human with long blonde hair and a flowing beard, clad in gleaming chainmail and carrying a shield; his striking blue eyes reflect unwavering faith. Beside him is Puss N. Boots, a small orange Tabaxi with large ears and bright green eyes, adorned in studded leather armor, a fancy belt, and a turquoise pirate hat feathered with peacock plumes. Tiktik Spellfeather, a medium-sized ravenlike Kenku draped in robes with a side pack, exudes a dark and brooding aura. Finally, Juna, a tall wood-elf with tan skin and vivid purple eyes, wears breeches and wields a great axe alongside two hand axes, her youthful intensity barely contained.

You stand at the edge of a narrow dirt path winding into the dense forest ahead. Around you, the towering ancient trees stretch their leafy canopies skyward, filtering speckled sunlight onto the mossy ground. To the north, the path disappears into shadowed woods; to the south, the forest gives way to open fields dotted with wildflowers. Nearby, a faint scent of pine mingles with the earthy aroma of damp soil.
